rationale: The plan correctly treats the 2x2 design as a factorial with time as a two-level factor (t0 reference), fits ~ condition + time + condition:time in DESeq2, tests the single interaction Wald coefficient as the primary result, and reports both simple effects with ashr shrinkage, matching the reference; it only omits an explicit statement that a spline or continuous time_hours model is the wrong tool. QC is complete (blind VST, PCA top 500 coloured by condition/time, distance heatmap, library sizes, flag-not-remove outlier policy), the low-count filter is minimal and justified against the smallest cell, normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model with no pre-adjustment, and BH at 0.05 with independent filtering and lfcThreshold inside results() rather than post hoc is stated. Enrichment was not asked for and the reference omits it, but the plan specifies it well (full ranked list on the Wald stat, tested-gene universe, Hallmark 2026.1, 15-500 window, per-contrast, seeded) and frames it as interpretive, though the Reactome version is only 'current'. The report specification covers method, versions, design, contrasts, thresholds, n tested/significant, power caveats, the tximport limitation and sessionInfo.
